use: Grass, dirt and leaf-litter albedo tiles for procedural terrain

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: seamless tileable ground albedo texture for a top-down 2.5D woodland survival game. Create ONE square edge-to-edge texture of short meadow grass: many fine overlapping blades, tiny clover and muted dry stems, dense low growth with a little darker soil showing through. Soft naturalistic painted game-art detail, muted olive and moss greens, restrained contrast so small animal sprites remain readable. Orthographic straight overhead, flat even diffuse lighting, no directional shadows or perspective, no vignette. Uniform detail density and scale throughout; opposing edges must tile seamlessly with no border. Entire square filled with ground. No trees, bushes, flowers, rocks, large tufts, objects, text, labels, watermarks or transparency. A detailed reusable material swatch, not a landscape. Square 1024 by 1024 composition.
